exposure: GDM women with low HbA1c (<6.0%) ≥30 days after interventions
finding: Residual risk associations exist between hyperglycemia and adverse pregnancy outcomes, particularly excess newborn birth weight and preterm delivery, despite glycemic control interventions in women with GDM.
mod_finding: Isolated fasting GDM was associated with an increased risk of primary cesarean section, while isolated post-load GDM was associated with a decreased risk, compared to non-GDM women.
